c.x: ClickUp, built around the way your teams deliver

OG Labs is a ClickUp certified partner. We design and optimise ClickUp workspaces that give you real visibility over projects, remove status-update busywork, and scale as your team grows. From workspace architecture and custom fields to dashboards and automations, we make ClickUp work the way your business actually runs.
Custom ClickUp spaces, folders, and lists architected to match how your team actually works.
Automated task creation, status updates, and notifications that eliminate manual admin work.
Team onboarding, training sessions, and ongoing support to drive adoption across your organisation.
Spaces, folders, lists, hierarchy, statuses and custom fields designed for clarity and reporting. Built to be understood by everyone on the team, not just admins.
Connecting ClickUp to HubSpot, Slack, email, finance and your wider tech stack so work and data stay aligned across tools.
Removing manual handoffs with native ClickUp automations and deeper logic via Make and n8n for anything ClickUp cannot handle natively.
Moving from Asana, Monday, Jira, Trello or spreadsheets, with data prepared and imported cleanly so nothing is lost.
Real-time views of workload, capacity, project health and delivery for both teams and leadership, built into the workspace.
Role-based training sessions and documentation so every team member knows how to use their part of the workspace and adoption holds.
We document how work moves through your teams today before designing anything.
We architect your spaces, hierarchy, permissions and custom fields around your real workflows.
We configure ClickUp in sessions with your team and gather feedback as we build, so the result fits from day one.
User acceptance testing with your team, then data import and go-live with people confident in the system.
Training, documentation and ongoing optimisation so the workspace grows with your business.
Do we need a certified consultant to set up ClickUp?

It is not required, but a structured build avoids the rework and sprawl that come from learning on the fly, and it drives adoption much faster. Most self-built workspaces get rebuilt within six months.
Can you migrate us from Asana, Monday or Jira?
Yes. We prepare and import your data and rebuild your workflows so nothing is lost in the move.
Can ClickUp replace several of our existing tools?
Often yes. ClickUp can absorb task management, docs, goals and time tracking, reducing your tech stack and licence costs.
Can ClickUp connect to our CRM?
Yes. We integrate ClickUp with HubSpot and other CRMs using Make and n8n so sales handoffs flow straight into delivery without manual rekeying.
Do you offer ongoing ClickUp support?
Yes, through optimisation retainers and managed services so your workspace keeps pace with how your business changes.
ClickUp certified partner for the Asia-Pacific region
From workspace design to full automation, OG Labs makes ClickUp work for your business.
